reason: Provides per-Agent progressive discovery and unlocking of installed tools through deterministic search while preserving the Harness runtime and existing policy controls.

summaries.zh: 为每个智能体提供按需搜索和解锁已安装工具的渐进式工具面板。
summaries.en: Provides each agent with progressive search and unlocking of installed tools through a per-agent tool palette.

capabilities: Progressively searches installed global tool schemas
Unlocks matching tools for later steps within an Agent lifecycle
Applies reversible per-Agent tool visibility restrictions
Updates native and Code Mode tool presentations after unlocking
